text: I got sick at 55 miles and only restarted riding at 40 miles a week. I have another race in eight weeks.
I deferred after my knee injury flared again. PT helped, but the fit issue is still unresolved.
I felt good early, then missed my fueling and bonked in the last hour.
I went too hard on the first climb and blew up in the back half.
A flat tire and then a broken chain ended the day.
